crossRefs.note: Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown…
Tell them, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, you kings of Judah, all Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, that enter in by…
Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
So the nations will fear Yahweh’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.
The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.
Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.
He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.
Yahweh said to Samuel, “Behold, I will do a thing in Israel at which both the ears of everyone who hears it will tingle.
The man said to Eli, “I am he who came out of the army, and I fled today out of the army.” He said, “How did the matter…
therefore Yahweh the God of Israel says, ‘Behold, I bring such evil on Jerusalem and Judah that whoever hears of it…
I will stretch over Jerusalem the line of Samaria, and the plummet of Ahab’s house; and I will wipe Jerusalem as a man…
As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Say, ‘Hear Yahweh’s word, kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says, “Behold, I will bring evil on this place, which whoever hears, his ears will tingle.
translations.bsb: saying, ‘Hear the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah and residents of Jerusalem. This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: I am going to bring such disaster on this place that the ears of all who hear of it will ring,
translations.kjv: And say, Hear ye the word of the LORD, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem; Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, the which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.
translations.asv: and say, Hear ye the word of Jehovah, O kings of Judah, and inhabitants of Jerusalem: thus saith Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, Behold, I will bring evil upon this place, which whosoever heareth, his ears shall tingle.
